Rincian lengkap Proyek Akhir Semester (tema, aturan, tahapan, rubrik penilaian) untuk Semester Gasal 2026/2027 akan diunggah di halaman ini menyusul, mengikuti jadwal berikut:

- **Guideline dirilis:** Minggu 10 (26-30 Oktober)
- **Checkpoint 1** (Mobile App Scoping, Project API): Minggu 12 (9-13 November)
- **Deadline akhir:** Minggu 15 (30 November - 4 Desember)

Lihat halaman **Jadwal** untuk detail tanggal terbaru.
:::

Full details for the Final Group Project (theme, rules, stages, grading rubric) for Odd Semester 2026/2027 will be uploaded to this page later, following this schedule:

- **Guideline released:** Week 10 (Oct 26-30)
- **Checkpoint 1** (Mobile App Scoping, Project API): Week 12 (Nov 9-13)
- **Final deadline:** Week 15 (Nov 30 - Dec 4)

See the **Schedule** page for the latest dates.
:::
